title: Making Luria Broth (LB)
author: Angela N Kaczmarczyk
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.i6gchbw

steps.title: Calculate LB Powder Requirements
steps.instruction: Determine the required grams per liter of LB powder needed to make the liquid media by reading the instructions on the LB container.

steps.title: Weigh and Transfer LB Powder
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer the LB powder to a bottle using a sterile spoon and weigh tray, handling the powder slowly to avoid dust dispersal and inhalation.

substeps.instruction: Spoon LB powder onto a weigh tray using a sterile spoon.
Pinch the tray corners and carefully pour the powder into the bottle.

steps.title: Add Distilled Water
steps.instruction: Add the required volume of distilled water to the bottle.

substeps.instruction: Measure 100 mL (or desired volume) of distilled water in a graduated cylinder.
Add the water to the bottle and close it.

steps.title: Mix and Prepare for Autoclave
steps.instruction: Mix the media and prepare the bottle for sterilization.

substeps.instruction: Loosen the cap so that it is almost falling off.
Secure the cap with a piece of autoclave tape.
Label the front of the bottle with name, date, and 'LB broth' using non-autoclave tape.

steps.title: Autoclave the Media
steps.instruction: Sterilize the LB broth in the autoclave.

substeps.instruction: Place an object at the bottom of the autoclave basket to prevent bottles from being submerged.
Place the bottle in the autoclave basket and autoclave according to autoclave instructions.

steps.title: Post-Autoclave Storage
steps.instruction: Remove the media from the autoclave and store it properly.

substeps.instruction: Remove the bottle from the autoclave per autoclave instructions.
Twist the cap closed to seal the LB.
Place the bottle in the autoclaved media bin with the label, date, and name.
